query MyCalendarChannels($connectedAccountId: UUID) {
  myCalendarChannels(connectedAccountId: $connectedAccountId) {
    id
    handle
    visibility
    syncStatus
    syncStage
    syncStageStartedAt
    isContactAutoCreationEnabled
    contactAutoCreationPolicy
    excludePrivateEvents
    isSyncEnabled
    connectedAccountId
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    __typename
  }
}
